body.title: CONTRACTOR CONFIDENTIALITY AND ACCEPTABLE USE ACKNOWLEDGMENT

body.p: I am placed with {{fontara_entity}} ("Fontara") by {{agency}} (the "Agency"), which employs me. My Fontara manager is {{manager}}. I give this acknowledgment to Fontara directly, because my assignment gives me access to Fontara's systems and to information about Fontara's customers and their users.

I will keep confidential all non-public information I learn through my assignment, including Fontara's business information and its customers' data: the names, contact details, messages and files in support tickets, account settings and any data I handle in an implementation or migration. I will use it only to do the work Fontara assigns me, and I will not copy it, send it or keep it outside the systems Fontara provides. This duty continues after my assignment ends.

body.h: 2. Acceptable Use of Accounts and Systems

body.p: My Fontara accounts are for me alone. I will not share a password or a sign-in code, I will use multi-factor authentication where Fontara requires it, and I will access only the customers, tickets and records my work needs. I will not paste customer data into a tool or service Fontara has not approved, including an AI service, and I will not try to get around a security control. Fontara may monitor my use of its systems.

I will work on customer data only on a device Fontara provides or approves, keep it locked and updated, and not use it for personal downloads or software Fontara has not approved. I will report a lost or stolen device to Fontara at once.

On my last day, or earlier if Fontara or the Agency asks, I will return every Fontara device and any copy of Fontara or customer information I hold, and my access to Fontara's systems will end. I will tell my Fontara manager if my assignment's end date changes.

I will report to Fontara's security team, within 24 hours of noticing it, anything that suggests customer data or a Fontara account has been seen, taken or used by someone not allowed to, including a request from anyone, inside or outside Fontara, to collect customer data for them.

This acknowledgment does not make me an employee of Fontara or change my employment with the Agency or the agreement between Fontara and the Agency. If I do not follow it, Fontara may end my access and ask the Agency to end my assignment with Fontara.
[[check:Contractor:Accepts the acknowledgment]] I have read this acknowledgment and agree to follow it from the date I sign it.
